run_sentence_dedup_signature: run SentenceDedupSignature to create hash signatures for each sentence in a document pipeline
run_sentence_find_dedups: run SentenceFindDedups to detect duplicate n-sentence spans across documents using a priority queue
run_sentence_dedup_filter: run SentenceDedupFilter to remove duplicate sentences from documents and filter by minimum word count
build_sentence_dedup_index: build a sentence deduplication index from signature files for cross-dataset deduplication
configure_sent_dedup: configure SentDedupConfig with n_sentences, min_doc_words, and hash settings for sentence deduplication
